heading: What I'm building now
lead: At Particle41 I lead backend architecture for multi-tenant SaaS products, and run an internal initiative building agentic developer tooling alongside it.

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS backends
items.body: Leading backend architecture and delivery for Synemi and Nigel — tenant isolation, event-driven services on AWS, and the financial layer covering subscription billing, credit balances, and A/R aging. Directing a team of up to seven and setting the clean-architecture and test-coverage standards that hold as the team grows.

items.title: Agentic Software Factory
items.body: An internal initiative at Particle41: AI developer tooling that takes a product requirements document and generates a working application from it. The hard parts are orchestration across multiple agents, keeping generated code inside architectural guardrails, and building the evaluation loop that tells you whether the output is actually good.
